objective: Explain pair selectivity and objective-induced disagreement on A, with targeted cold-target checks and existing public models.

drug_only.control: No target information; constant within a drug-to-target query.

protein_only.control: No drug information; constant within a target-to-drug query.

lightgbm.reporting_checkpoint: Best bidirectional query-macro AP among saved 25-tree checkpoints; test never selects.

drugban_native.training: Fresh full task model; vanilla supervised DrugBAN, no domain adaptation.
drugban_native.claim: Native-input system comparison. Cannot isolate local attention from encoder, input and training differences.
preflight_required: Freeze model-specific implementation settings before fitting
drugban_native.hyperparameter_status: Adapter and exact model-specific training settings pending; not execution-ready.

inputs.normalize: Per-feature training-only mean/std; persist and reuse on validation/test.
inputs.esm2_window: Original DTIAM-compatible first 1022 residues with its documented pooling, unchanged across controls.
inputs.optional_drugclip: 14,533 required drug embeddings unavailable; mask explicitly or use a separately declared common-coverage comparison.
inputs.structure_increment: Token/atom/structure models require an additional input-control experiment; pooled features are not local geometry.
inputs.scope: The seven common-input controls share BerMol/ESM2. Native DrugBAN is a separately labeled input-and-architecture comparison.

labels.inequalities: Inherit audited bounds; a censored interval that crosses a boundary does not establish that label.
labels.explicit_inactive: Audited experimental inactivity retained as binary negative; never fabricated numeric Kd.
labels.arm_A: Kd/Ki binary evidence plus explicit inactivity
labels.regression: Separate exact Kd and Ki heads only. Inactivity has no fabricated numeric affinity.

neural_training.initialization: Fresh trainable layers, frozen common encoders
neural_training.projection: Linear -> LayerNorm -> GELU, identical corresponding towers
neural_training.sampling: Uniform observed pairs with no permanent per-target cap and no invented decoys.
neural_training.checkpoint: Max validation bidirectional query-macro AP; missing direction is not imputed.
neural_training.convergence: No validation improvement for patience after minimum epochs; never assert mathematical convergence.
neural_training.mixed_precision: Disabled for initial parity pilot; optional later amendment must be logged.
neural_training.train_repeats: Three prespecified seeds; retain all outcomes including failure.
neural_training.hyperparameters: Initial controlled settings fixed here; further tuning is a separately logged sensitivity study, never test-selected.

losses.binary: BCEWithLogits on eligible observed binary labels, unweighted in primary architecture study.
losses.ranking: Equal query weighting, half target-to-drug and half drug-to-target where measured positive/negative comparisons exist; softplus(-(s_pos-s_neg)).
losses.ranking_context: Binary label-order regularization across queried measurements; not claimed to be within-assay continuous affinity ordering.
losses.regression: Huber loss per exact endpoint; average within endpoint then over available endpoints.
losses.regression_scaling: p-activity centered/scaled using training rows for that endpoint only; save scales.
losses.unlabelled_auxiliary: Unavailable endpoint/loss masked, not zero-filled as a label.
losses.assay_sensitivity: Optional within-assay ranking only for same target/endpoint/source, >=5 distinct training members after filtering, delta p-activity >=0.3.
losses.assay_scope: Use only A membership and Kd/Ki rows. Original A scaffold train has 192469 exact endpoint rows; current min5 filtered assay rows are reported in counts.

metrics.checkpoint_summary: Arithmetic mean of the two directions; both direction scores and query counts always reported.

topk.labels: Measured-panel P@10 only when all compared predictions in that panel have usable measurements. Never call this full-catalog P@10.
topk.ties: Exact expected boundary membership for overlap and P@K; average ranks for correlations.
topk.constant: Undefined correlation reported with count; constant-score ranking AP equals that query prevalence.

metrics.random_baseline: AUROC=0.5; independent TopK overlap=K^2/N; uninformative constant-score AP=prevalence. Finite random-order AP reference computed by permutations.
metrics.inactive_fpr: Choose score threshold on validation positives at >=90% recall, then freeze; report achieved test recall and FPR on explicit-inactive subset.
metrics.regression_comparison: Same endpoint and comparable assay; report label spread and censoring separately.
metrics.single_class: Report counts and applicable false-positive or recall summaries; exclude from mixed-query AP with explicit denominator.
metrics.classification_vs_affinity: Do not interpret similarity/logit as Kd or calibrated probability.

inference_track.scope: Reuse frozen public/production checkpoints and historical A/B fits for exploratory references; no new B fits.
inference_track.heads: Nesso binder and pIC50=6-log10(IC50/uM) analyzed separately; DTBind occurrence/affinity/site are separate tasks.
inference_track.nesso_gates: 0.5 and per-query Top50 are already viewed exploratory diagnostics; no retrospectively invented primary threshold.
inference_track.missing: Retain missing/unsupported/error distinctions and report coverage; no zero imputation.
inference_track.extra_models: EviDTI and Scope only after native example replay, feature parity and applicable target-universe checks.

statistical_plan.unit: Query-level paired contrasts; targets grouped by homology, drugs by scaffold; documents audited separately.
statistical_plan.dependence: For pooled or cross-query metrics use crossed scaffold x target-cluster resampling; add document-cluster sensitivity and disclose independent units.
statistical_plan.seeds: Three seed-level values plus mean/range; pair bootstrap does not convert three fits into thousands of independent fits.
statistical_plan.primary_family: Scaffold: global_mlp vs additive/dual_cosine/lightgbm, two directions (6); cold-target: global_mlp vs additive/lightgbm, two directions (4). Holm correction across 10 primary tests.
statistical_plan.secondary: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR for prespecified secondary families; post-hoc diagnostics labeled exploratory.
statistical_plan.effect_size: Report paired absolute AP difference and uncertainty, not significance alone.
statistical_plan.causal_scope: Only controlled fresh training supports attribution to the changed factor; public deployed architecture comparisons are observational.
statistical_plan.local_model: DrugBAN native comparison is secondary, with matched evaluation members and explicit input/truncation differences.

selection_protocol.keep_tests_sealed_for_new_fits: No early stopping, weights, gates or feature normalization from test.
selection_protocol.interpretation: Historical label access is disclosed despite prospective run rules.
selection_protocol.equal_compute: Save common update-step checkpoints and unique-pair exposure; compare both convergence-selected and equal-update budgets.
selection_protocol.data_contrasts: Large A/B matched/nested retraining deferred. Existing B results retained as historical supplementation, not proof of an endpoint-noise cause.
selection_protocol.no_150_deletion: Reuse existing rotating-150/balanced results as exploratory. Any new sampler comparison rotates examples and logs exposure, never silently discards all later records.
selection_protocol.fusion: Weights selected on validation. Compare best single, training-only chemical nearest neighbor, rank-mean fusion, and disagreement risk at equal retained budget.
selection_protocol.existing_dtiam_A: Reuse three historical fits for common-member re-evaluation. Training protocol differs, so exclude them from strict same-budget architecture attribution.
selection_protocol.cold_target: Fresh supervised fits on A_cold_target; no reuse of original scaffold-trained task checkpoints as unseen-target models.

execution.training_runner_status: Planning amendment only; common trainer and DrugBAN adapter still need implementation.
stages: A3 native DrugBAN scaffold:3 after adapter qualification
execution.resources: Existing Nesso/DTBind production jobs retained; no new GPU allocation by this preparation.
execution.scheduling: One GPU job at a time after resource availability; CPU-heavy tasks <=4 threads during current inference.
execution.new_training_eta: Not profiled. Counts are runs, not a claim of equal compute or duration.
execution.amendment: Append versioned deviations with reason and whether validation/test outcomes were known; never rewrite a completed protocol version silently.
execution.conditional_rule: Source-purged, ReLU and TAPB hypotheses must be activated/frozen before examining their corresponding test results; they do not enter the default run queue.

release.weights: Publish retrieval manifests and hashes; redistribute bytes only when the specific weight terms allow it.
release.raw_data: Retain original source/assay/identity references and license metadata; publish derived members or rebuild scripts as permitted.
release.heldout: No test labels or SPR results exposed to training loader by default.

user_direction: Use A for the main training/validation/test study. No large-scale new B training.
